summaries.summary: The page explains that Sahaja Aharam is an F2C initiative aiming to create a meeting ground for nature-friendly consumers and farmers by blending traditional bazaars with ecological concerns. It describes how this initiative builds a new supply chain using a Farmer to Consumer (F2C) model to increase farmers' income and provide consumers with healthy, diverse food through direct retailing and partnerships.
key_facts: Sahaja Aharam is an F2C initiative for nature-friendly consumers and farmers.
It blends traditional bazaars with ecological concerns.
It builds a new supply chain using the F2C model.
It increases farmers' income by offering better prices (50% over cost of production and 50% of consumer price) for locally grown produce from ecological farming.
It provides more employment opportunities through value addition and selling processed produce.
It gives consumers access to healthy and diverse food.
It uses direct retailing to consumers (bulk/individual) and partnerships.
